test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 13

questions.question: Read the following table carefully and answer the question given below.The following table shows the number of copies sold by five types of newspapers in urban and rural areas.						News Paper			Urban area			Rural area							Indian Express			2000			1000							Times of India			4000			1000							The Hindu			4500			1500							Amar Ujala			2000			4500							Dainik Jagran			1500			5500			Find the ratio of the number of copies sold by Indian Express in urban area to the number of copies sold by The Hindu in rural area.
The volume (in m3) of a cuboidal tank, whose dimensions are given as 33 m × 6 m × 34 m, is:

Three friends, A, B, and C started a business by investing in the ratio of 8 : 9 : 10. After 6 months, A withdraws half of his capital. If C's investment is ₹30,000 and the total annual profit is ₹50,000, what is the difference between the profits of A and B?
The simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,800 at the rate of 10% per annum in 3 years is:
The ratio of the cost prices of articles X and Y is 3 : 4. A man earns a profit of 15% by selling X and loses 20% by selling Y. What is his gain/loss percentage in the entire transaction?
A dealer allowed 73% discount on an article and was still able to manage 33% profit. Find the ratio of the cost price to the listed price.

₹13,335 is divided among Sunil, Krishna, and Naveen so that Sunil received half as much as Krishna and Naveen together and Krishna received one fourth as much as Sunil and Naveen together. What is the sum of Sunil’s and Krishna’s share (in ₹) together?
In a test, B got 52 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 80 maximum marks. What approximate percentage of A's marks were B's marks?
Anshuman and Kunal together invested ₹67,300 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹20,000, Kunal's share was ₹7,800. What was the difference of their investment?5981
The present population of a town is 31,48,475. It has been increasing at a rate of 7% every year. Find the population of the town two years ago.
While going to a shopping mall, Anjali travels at a speed of 63 km/hr and on her way back, she travels at a speed of 99 km/hr. What is her average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey?11338
The arithmetic mean of the observations 49, 78, 32, 67, 43, 19, 16, 91 and 64 is:6333
What is the difference between the average of prime numbers between 80 and 90 and the average of multiples of 3 between 70 and 80?
The fourth proportional to 5, a and 13a is 65. What is the positive value of a?

In a river, water is flowing with a speed of 3 km/hr. A motor boat takes equal time in going 88 km downstream and 44 km upstream. How much time will it take to cover 84 km downstream and 84 km upstream?7652
The diagonals of a rhombus are 12 cm and 8 cm, respectively. The area of the rhombus (in cm2) is:
A car travels 180 km in 4 hours. If it increases its speed by 15 km/hr, how long will it take to travel the same distance?
The simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,800 at the rate of 10% per annum in 2 years is:
Ronit spends 45% of his salary on food and travel. He spends one-fifth of his remaining salary on books. If he saves the remaining ₹13,200 every month, then what is his monthly salary (in ₹)?
At what rate (in percentage) per year will a sum of money double itself in 10 years on simple interest?
